title: Tumor Associated Neutrophils Extend NETs To Spatially Drive Necroptosis In Glioblastoma.
publicationName: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
journalName: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
snippet: Glioblastoma is pathologically characterized by extensive pseudopalisading necrosis, a hallmark linked to therapeutic resistance and dismal prognosis. While traditionally viewed as a passive ischemic event, the precise radiogenomic drivers and spatial immune architectures orchestrating active tumor necrosis remain poorly understood.
